texts.zh:

texts.en:
The usual dissonance of the Fallen Empire fragments is gone. The three voices harmonize, each one filled with rage.

Senseless [owner.GetSpeciesName]! You have entered the Final Thought system. Let us be clear: this place is not for your [owner.GetEyeNamePlural]. Proceed, and the consequences will be unimaginable, your pain - unendurable.

You will not disturb us - it - me.

texts.zh:
